domain: lobbying, legal, consulting, audit, placement, registered-agent, compliance, and public-affairs intermediaries
scope: The firms and individuals that translate between capital, public authority, regulation, transactions, and institutions: lobbying registrants, foreign agents, law firms, consultancies, auditors, placement agents, registered agents, compliance providers, and named engagement teams. The estate distinguishes legal representation, lobbying, advisory work, filing agency, and operational control.
why_new_estate: Dialog, defense, capital, ethics, and development work repeatedly reach advisers and filing agents, but those roles currently sit as incidental edges rather than a bounded corpus.

denominator_contract.unit: one disclosed or officially evidenced engagement between an exact intermediary and exact client or matter
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Filed lobbying or foreign-agent reports, Form ADV/IAPD records, public contracts, court appearances, audit appointments, and official corporate filings.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Website logos or generic client lists without date and entity resolution; shared adviser as proof of client-to-client relationship.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: registered but no report in bounded window
client listed with no matching matter

source_routes.bounded_output: Foreign-principal registrations, registrants, short forms, informational materials, agreements, and supplemental statements.
source_routes.residual_fog: Filed disclosure does not prove activity outside the filed scope; exemptions, amendments, late filings, and client legal identity remain.

source_routes.authority: Secretary of the U.S. Senate and Clerk of the House
source_routes.bounded_output: Lobbying registrations and quarterly reports keyed by registrant, client, issue, and filing identifier.
source_routes.residual_fog: Client and registrant legal-entity resolution, covered-position history, and exact decision windows remain.

source_routes.authority: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / FINRA
source_routes.bounded_output: Investment adviser firms, CRD/SEC identifiers, Form ADV filings, ownership, control persons, private funds, business activities, and disciplinary disclosures.
source_routes.residual_fog: Form ADV is self-reported and point-in-time; affiliated vehicles, historical filings, client engagements, and legal ownership require separate resolution.

source_routes.bounded_output: Company numbers, officers, PSCs, filing history, charges, insolvency, and document identifiers.
source_routes.residual_fog: Filed information may be inaccurate; document images, historical names, foreign entities, and legal-identity adjudication require further checks.

source_routes.bounded_output: State-level lobbyist, client, employer, report, compensation, and subject-matter filings where public.
source_routes.residual_fog: Coverage, identifiers, reporting thresholds, historical access, and searchable fields vary by jurisdiction.

source_routes.authority: U.S. Office of Government Ethics and agency ethics offices
source_routes.bounded_output: Public financial disclosures, PTRs, ethics agreements, certifications, recusals, waivers, and divestiture certificates.
source_routes.residual_fog: OGE holds only part of the filer universe; agency-by-agency requests, six-year retention limits, and lawful-use attestations remain.

boundaries: A shared adviser, law firm, registered agent, or lobbying firm is an intermediary overlap only. It does not establish coordination, common control, knowledge, influence, or causation.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
